import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/titanic.csv')

# Set style
sns.set_style("whitegrid")
plt.figure(figsize=(16, 10))

# Create subplots
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 3, figsize=(18, 12))

# 1. Survival by passenger class and gender
survival_pclass_sex = df.groupby(['pclass', 'sex', 'alive']).size().unstack().fillna(0)
survival_pclass_sex_percentage = survival_pclass_sex.div(survival_pclass_sex.sum(axis=1), axis=0) * 100

ax1 = axes[0, 0]
survival_pclass_sex_percentage.plot(kind='bar', stacked=True, ax=ax1, color=['#e74c3c', '#2ecc71'])
ax1.set_title('Survival Rate by Passenger Class and Gender', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_xlabel('Passenger Class and Gender', fontsize=12)
ax1.set_ylabel('Percentage (%)', fontsize=12)
ax1.set_xticklabels(['1st Class\nMale', '1st Class\nFemale', 
                     '2nd Class\nMale', '2nd Class\nFemale',
                     '3rd Class\nMale', '3rd Class\nFemale'], rotation=0)
ax1.legend(['Did Not Survive', 'Survived'], title='Survival Status')
ax1.grid(True, alpha=0.3)

# 2. Age distribution by survival status
ax2 = axes[0, 1]
survived_age = df[df['alive'] == 'yes']['age'].dropna()
not_survived_age = df[df['alive'] == 'no']['age'].dropna()

ax2.hist([survived_age, not_survived_age], bins=20, label=['Survived', 'Did Not Survive'], 
         color=['#2ecc71', '#e74c3c'], alpha=0.7, edgecolor='black')
ax2.set_title('Age Distribution by Survival Status', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
ax2.set_xlabel('Age', fontsize=12)
ax2.set_ylabel('Count', fontsize=12)
ax2.legend()
ax2.grid(True, alpha=0.3)

# 3. Fare distribution by passenger class
ax3 = axes[0, 2]
fare_data = [df[df['pclass'] == i]['fare'].dropna() for i in range(1, 4)]
box = ax3.boxplot(fare_data, patch_artist=True, labels=['1st Class', '2nd Class', '3rd Class'])
colors = ['#3498db', '#f39c12', '#9b59b6']
for patch, color in zip(box['boxes'], colors):
    patch.set_facecolor(color)
    patch.set_alpha(0.7)

ax3.set_title('Fare Distribution by Passenger Class', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
ax3.set_xlabel('Passenger Class', fontsize=12)
ax3.set_ylabel('Fare', fontsize=12)
ax3.grid(True, alpha=0.3)

# 4. Survival rate by embarkation port
ax4 = axes[1, 0]
embark_survival = df.groupby(['embark_town', 'alive']).size().unstack().fillna(0)
embark_survival_percentage = embark_survival.div(embark_survival.sum(axis=1), axis=0) * 100

x = np.arange(len(embark_survival_percentage.index))
width = 0.35
bars1 = ax4.bar(x - width/2, embark_survival_percentage['no'], width, 
                label='Did Not Survive', color='#e74c3c', alpha=0.8)
bars2 = ax4.bar(x + width/2, embark_survival_percentage['yes'], width, 
                label='Survived', color='#2ecc71', alpha=0.8)

ax4.set_title('Survival Rate by Embarkation Port', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
ax4.set_xlabel('Embarkation Port', fontsize=12)
ax4.set_ylabel('Percentage (%)', fontsize=12)
ax4.set_xticks(x)
ax4.set_xticklabels(embark_survival_percentage.index)
ax4.legend()
ax4.grid(True, alpha=0.3)

# Add value labels on bars
for bars in [bars1, bars2]:
    for bar in bars:
        height = bar.get_height()
        ax4.text(bar.get_x() + bar.get_width()/2., height + 0.5,
                f'{height:.1f}%', ha='center', va='bottom', fontsize=9)

# 5. Family size vs survival
ax5 = axes[1, 1]
df['family_size'] = df['sibsp'] + df['parch'] + 1
family_survival = df.groupby(['family_size', 'alive']).size().unstack().fillna(0)
family_survival_percentage = family_survival.div(family_survival.sum(axis=1), axis=0) * 100

# Limit to reasonable family sizes for better visualization
family_survival_percentage = family_survival_percentage[family_survival_percentage.index <= 8]

family_survival_percentage.plot(kind='bar', stacked=True, ax=ax5, color=['#e74c3c', '#2ecc71'])
ax5.set_title('Survival Rate by Family Size', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
ax5.set_xlabel('Family Size (including passenger)', fontsize=12)
ax5.set_ylabel('Percentage (%)', fontsize=12)
ax5.legend(['Did Not Survive', 'Survived'], title='Survival Status')
ax5.grid(True, alpha=0.3)

# 6. Survival rate by age group and passenger class
ax6 = axes[1, 2]
df['age_group'] = pd.cut(df['age'], bins=[0, 12, 18, 30, 50, 80], 
                         labels=['Child (0-12)', 'Teen (13-18)', 'Young Adult (19-30)', 
                                 'Adult (31-50)', 'Senior (51+)'])

age_class_survival = df.groupby(['age_group', 'pclass', 'alive']).size().unstack().fillna(0)
age_class_survival_percentage = age_class_survival.div(age_class_survival.sum(axis=1), axis=0) * 100

# Get survival rates for each class
for i, pclass in enumerate([1, 2, 3], 1):
    class_data = age_class_survival_percentage.xs(pclass, level='pclass')
    ax6.plot(class_data.index.astype(str), class_data['yes'], 
             marker='o', linewidth=2, markersize=8, label=f'Class {pclass}')

ax6.set_title('Survival Rate by Age Group and Passenger Class', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
ax6.set_xlabel('Age Group', fontsize=12)
ax6.set_ylabel('Survival Rate (%)', fontsize=12)
ax6.legend(title='Passenger Class')
ax6.grid(True, alpha=0.3)
ax6.set_ylim(0, 100)

# Adjust layout
plt.suptitle('Titanic Passenger Survival Analysis', fontsize=18, fontweight='bold', y=1.02)
plt.tight_layout()

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150, facecolor='white')
plt.close()
